data.long_description:
Experience the epitome of luxury living with this stunning apartment at Habtoor Grand Residences, boasting panoramic city views. Located in the heart of Dubai, this residence blends elegance with modern comfort. The spacious interiors are enhanced by sleek, contemporary finishes and expansive windows that offer a breathtaking view of the vibrant city skyline.

Prime Locations Nearby:

JBR Beach
Dubai Marina
The Palm Jumeirah
Bluewaters Island
Dubai Harbour
Burj Al Arab
Waldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah
Atlantis The Palm
Atlantis The Royal, Palm Jumeirah

Residents of Habtoor Grand Residences enjoy access to premium amenities, including luxurious swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and exclusive concierge services, all designed to elevate your lifestyle. Surrounded by a lively neighborhood filled with top dining, entertainment, and beach activities, this apartment offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience in the heart of Dubai’s most prestigious locations.
